components.name: Mast
components.description: Full-bleed navy header with AthletIQ (red Q) and the Health pill.
components.html:
AthletIQ

Health
components.css: .ds-mast { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; min-height: 3.5rem; padding: 0 1.35rem; background: #17408b; color: #ffffff; font-family: "Source Sans 3", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-mast__brand { margin: 0; font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; line-height: 1; } .ds-mast__q { color: #c8102e; } .ds-mast__health { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; margin: 0; padding: 0.22rem 0.7rem 0.22rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; color: #ffffff; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #fff; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-mast__dot { width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; border-radius: 50%; background: #22c55e; } .ds-mast__health:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Health Chip
components.description: Title-case Health pill on navy: white outline, labeled pulse, green only for ok.
components.css: .ds-chip-health { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; margin: 0; padding: 0.22rem 0.7rem 0.22rem 0.5rem; font-family: "Source Sans 3", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; color: #ffffff; background: #17408b; border: 1px solid #fff; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-chip-health__dot { width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; border-radius: 50%; background: #93a4c0; } .ds-chip-health[data-state="ok"] .ds-chip-health__dot { background: #22c55e; } .ds-chip-health[data-state="down"] .ds-chip-health__dot { background: #f87171; } .ds-chip-health:hover { border-color: #fff; } .ds-chip-health:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sheet Card
components.description: White lookup/result sheet: 6px corners, hairline rule, one ambient shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d5dae2; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.14); padding: 1.05rem 1.2rem; font-family: "Source Sans 3", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: #12161c; } .ds-card__label { font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; color: #0b1c3a; }

components.name: Box-score Table
components.description: Navy uppercase heads, white cells, ink Yes/No — not a green win badge.
components.css: .ds-box { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: "Source Sans 3", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #12161c; } .ds-box th, .ds-box td { text-align: left; padding: 0.65rem 0.8rem; vertical-align: middle; } .ds-box th { background: #17408b; color: #ffffff; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-box th + th { border-left: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85); } .ds-box td { border-bottom: 1px solid #d5dae2; background: #ffffff; } .ds-box tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-box__win { font-weight: 700; color: #12161c; }

components.name: Probability Bar
components.description: Linear P(home win): percent, mist track, navy fill, 100% cap. Never a ring.

narrative.overview:
AthletIQ is a local stats-desk query: enter a loaded `game_id`, read the home-win call, then read the pin, methodology, and limitations. The craft is NBA.com/Stats executed straight — navy mast, a single red Q in the AthletIQ wordmark, white sheets on cool gray paper, navy box-score heads, Source Sans 3. It is not a betting board, not a live odds rail, and not a circular win meter.

Density is compact and tabular. Interactive labels stay title case. The page is one centered desk column, not an app shell with side rails. Probability is a numeric percent plus a linear navy fill. The home-win call is the words Yes or No in desk ink. Health is a labeled pill on the mast; color never carries that state alone.

This is a category-standard sports-analytics dashboard. Copy is English and names real endpoints. Focus rings are visible. The prediction is a disclosed estimate, not a scoreboard celebration.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed navy mast: AthletIQ with a red Q, white-outline Health pill
Cool gray paper field; exactly two white lifted sheets (lookup + result)
Source Sans 3 at 400 / 600 / 700; no second display face
Title-case Game ID, Predict, and Health; uppercase reserved for table heads, disclose titles, and error codes
Ink Yes/No; navy linear P(home win) bar; 32px navy circular medals on the paper, not on a third card

rules.name: The Red Q Rule
rules.body: Red is the Q and fault chrome. It is never a win, probability, or health-success fill.

rules.name: The Ink Call Rule
rules.body: Home-win Yes/No is desk ink on a white cell. Never green, never red, never a filled badge.

rules.name: The Title-Case Controls Rule
rules.body: Game ID, Predict, and Health stay title case with no tracking. Uppercase is only for box-score heads, disclose section titles, and error codes.

rules.name: The Desk Column Rule
rules.body: One stats-desk column. No sidebar, no betting rail, no app-shell navigation beyond the mast.

rules.name: The Two-Sheet Rule
rules.body: Only the lookup row and the result sheet lift. Methodology and Limitations stay on the paper, not in a third card.

rules.name: The Soft Sheet Rule
rules.body: 6px on sheets and controls. The Health chip is the only pill. Probability is a sharp rectangular bar, never a circular meter.

rules.name: The Linear Probability Rule
rules.body: P(home win) is a percent plus a navy fill in a cool rectangular track. No gauges, rings, or pie meters.

rules.name: The Medal Pair Rule
rules.body: Methodology and Limitations are a paired heading-plus-medal on the paper. Do not promote them into cards or kickers.

dos: Do keep the navy mast, red Q, Cool Paper field, and two white 6px sheets.
Do set Game ID, Predict, and Health in title case.
Do set Yes/No in Desk Ink and P(home win) as a linear navy bar.
Do show a 2px Focus Blue ring on keyboard focus.
Do pair disclose titles with the navy circular medals and leave those columns on the paper.
donts: Don't color the home-win call green or red, or wrap it in a success/fail badge.
Don't use a circular win meter, gauge, or pie for probability.
Don't lift Methodology/Limitations into a third card or add a sidebar/odds rail.
Don't all-caps Game ID, Predict, or Health, or add eyebrow kickers above titles.
Don't introduce a second display face or a glyph-icon font.
Don't spread Pulse OK green beyond the Health dot.
